nodes.body: Build an in-memory Todo service with a CLI whose value is its dependency shape: a real fan-out→join (types → {store, validation} → service) plus a cross-epic gate (cli waits on all of core) — the shape a flat plan cannot represent.

nodes.title: Join
nodes.body: Join — a slice depending on more than one upstream (service ← store + validation); unreachable until all upstream tokens land.

detail.definition: a slice depending on more than one upstream (service ← store + validation); unreachable until all upstream tokens land.

nodes.title: Cross-epic gate
nodes.body: Cross-epic gate — an epic-level dependency (cli ← core) that holds every downstream slice until the upstream epic fully clears.

detail.definition: an epic-level dependency (cli ← core) that holds every downstream slice until the upstream epic fully clears.

nodes.title: Fan-out
nodes.body: Fan-out — sibling slices sharing one upstream with no edge between them (store and validation from types), so they run concurrently.

detail.definition: sibling slices sharing one upstream with no edge between them (store and validation from types), so they run concurrently.

nodes.title: Command surface
nodes.body: Command surface — the thin cli epic: add/list/done functions over TodoService, not a standalone binary.

nodes.body:
Edges encode genuine build-order only, producing the diamond: types root; store and validation on types; service on both; commands on service.

Rationale: This shape is what justifies a Petri net over a flat plan.

Impact: high

nodes.title: Grounding exchange (ported interview)
nodes.body:
Q: Sketch layered-todo in one breath: what is it, and what dependency shape gives it value?

A: An in-memory Todo service + CLI whose value is its diamond join (service needs store and validation) plus a cross-epic gate (cli waits on core).

nodes.title: Design answer (ported interview)
nodes.body: Encode genuine build-order only — the diamond join on service plus a cross-epic gate holding cli behind core.
